title: Schengen short-stay (Type C) from Pakistan

provenance.summary: EU-wide rules are taken from Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 (the Visa Code) and are hard law, identical across all member states. Financial thresholds are set per member state and are cited individually. Anything marked 'heuristic' is our own calibration and is NOT an official requirement.

sources.title: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 — Community Code on Visas (Visa Code)
Your Europe — Travel documents for non-EU nationals
Schengen means of subsistence, amount required by each member state
Spain SMI 2026 (basis of the Spanish funds formula)
France Diplomatie — EES live from 10 April 2026

source_notes: STILL UNVERIFIED against live casework. The EU-level rules below are hard law and can be relied on; the per-state financial figures are published reference amounts that change without notice; the 'heuristic' rules are ours and are not official.
Passport rules (3 months' validity beyond departure, 2 blank pages, issued within the previous 10 years) are Visa Code Art. 12 and identical in every member state.
Insurance (EUR 30,000, emergency treatment, hospitalisation, repatriation for illness and for remains, valid across all Schengen states) is Visa Code Art. 15.

Funds are NOT harmonised. Published reference amounts range from EUR 34/day (Netherlands) to EUR 122.10/day (Spain), so this pack resolves the figure from the destination member state. Set applicant_meta.destination_country (ISO-3166 alpha-2) on the check; without it the pack falls back to Spain, the operator's main casework corridor.

Spain's amount is not a fixed number: Orden PRE/1282/2007 sets it at 10% of gross SMI per person per day, with a floor of 90% of gross SMI. SMI 2026 is EUR 1,221/month, giving EUR 122.10/day and a floor of EUR 1,098.90. When SMI changes each January, update only these two numbers.

EES (biometric Entry/Exit System) has been live at all Schengen external borders since 10 April 2026 and applies to visa holders too — expect fingerprint and facial capture on first entry. It is a border process, not a visa document, so it adds nothing to this checklist.
ETIAS (expected Q4 2026) applies only to visa-EXEMPT nationals. Pakistani passport holders need a visa, so ETIAS does NOT apply to them. Do not add it to this checklist.
Consulates commonly expect a margin above the bare minimum rather than an exact figure; the buffer wording in the funds rule reflects that and is deliberately not a hard threshold.
disclaimer: This is a document completeness check against a named checklist. It is not immigration advice and does not predict whether a visa will be granted.

fx.note: Indicative rates for threshold comparison only. Refresh periodically in /admin/rules; a stale rate makes the funds check wrong in both directions.

documents.label: Passport
documents.why: Visa Code Art. 12 requires a travel document valid for at least three months after the intended departure from the Schengen area, containing at least two blank pages, and issued within the previous ten years.
documents.fix: Upload a clear scan or photo of the bio-data page, including the two machine-readable lines at the bottom.

documents.label: Completed Schengen visa application form
documents.why: Visa Code Art. 11 requires the harmonised application form, completed and signed.
documents.fix: Complete and sign the Schengen visa application form for your destination consulate and include it in the bundle.

documents.label: Passport photograph
documents.why: Visa Code Art. 13 requires a photograph meeting ICAO standards. A non-compliant photo is the most common reason a submission is rejected at the counter rather than refused later.
documents.fix: Upload the digital photograph supplied by the studio: 35mm x 45mm, colour, plain light background, taken within the last 6 months.

documents.label: Travel medical insurance
documents.why: Visa Code Art. 15 requires cover of at least EUR 30,000 for emergency medical treatment, hospitalisation, and repatriation for medical reasons or death, valid throughout the Schengen area for the whole stay.
documents.fix: Buy a Schengen-compliant policy covering EUR 30,000 including repatriation, valid from departure to return. Most Pakistani insurers sell a specific 'Schengen' product.

documents.label: Bank statement
documents.why: Visa Code Art. 14 requires evidence of sufficient means of subsistence for the intended stay and for the return journey.
documents.fix: Obtain a bank statement covering the last 6 months, stamped and signed by the bank, showing your name and the closing balance.

documents.label: Flight reservation (round trip)
documents.why: Visa Code Art. 14 requires documents indicating the purpose of the journey, which for tourism means a round-trip itinerary showing intended entry and exit.
documents.fix: Add a round-trip flight reservation covering your intended travel dates. A reservation is normally sufficient; you do not need to buy the ticket before a decision.

documents.label: Proof of accommodation
documents.why: Visa Code Art. 14 requires proof of accommodation for the whole stay. A hotel booking or a host's formal invitation both satisfy this.
documents.fix: Add a hotel booking covering every night, or an invitation letter from your host with their full address.

documents.label: Cover letter
documents.why: Not required by the Visa Code, but expected by most consulates and the single best place to explain the trip, the funding and your ties before the officer has to infer them.
documents.fix: Write a one-page letter stating the purpose of travel, your exact dates, where you will stay, who is paying, and your ties to Pakistan.

documents.label: Employment letter / NOC
documents.why: Evidence of employment and approved leave is the ordinary way to show both your income and your reason to return.
documents.fix: Ask your employer for a letter on company letterhead stating your position, salary, joining date, and that your leave is approved for the travel dates.

documents.label: Business registration / NTN certificate
documents.why: Self-employed applicants must evidence the business that funds the trip and that they return to.
documents.fix: Include your business registration or NTN certificate together with your most recent tax return.

documents.label: Enrolment / bonafide certificate
documents.why: Students must evidence current enrolment and that the institution has no objection to the travel.
documents.fix: Ask your institution for a bonafide certificate confirming enrolment and no objection to your travel.

documents.label: Pension statement
documents.why: Retired applicants must evidence their ongoing income.
documents.fix: Include your pension payment order or recent pension credit statements.

documents.label: Tax return
documents.why: A filed return corroborates declared income and is one of the few Pakistani documents a consulate can cross-check independently.
documents.fix: Add your most recent FBR tax return acknowledgement.

documents.label: Property or asset documents
documents.why: Evidence of assets in Pakistan supports the case that you intend to return.
documents.fix: Consider adding property papers or other asset documentation.

documents.label: Previous visas / travel history
documents.why: A record of prior compliant travel is among the strongest positive signals available to an applicant from a high-refusal corridor.
documents.fix: Include copies of previous visas and entry/exit stamps if you have them.

rules.title: Your name is not written the same way on every document
rules.fix: Every document must show your name exactly as it appears in your passport. Where a bank, employer or airline issued the document, ask them to reissue it with the correct spelling.

rules.title: Passport number does not match across documents
rules.fix: Correct the passport number wherever it differs from the passport itself, and have any third-party document reissued.

rules.title: Date of birth does not match across documents
rules.passed_label: Date of birth matches across documents
rules.fix: Correct the date of birth to match your passport exactly.

rules.title: Passport validity
rules.passed_label: Passport validity meets Visa Code Art. 12
rules.fix: Renew your passport before applying. Visa Code Art. 12 requires validity for at least three months beyond your intended departure from the Schengen area, and the passport must have been issued within the previous ten years. Neither can be waived except in a justified emergency.

rules.title: Means of subsistence
rules.passed_label: Bank balance meets the destination's published amount
rules.fix: Build the balance well before you submit — funds that appear days before the appointment are read as borrowed. If someone else is funding the trip, add a sponsorship affidavit and the sponsor's own statements. France's figure drops to EUR 65/day when you hold proof of accommodation and rises to EUR 120/day when you do not.

rules.title: Bank statement recency
rules.fix: Download a fresh statement, ideally stamped and signed by the bank, dated within the last few days before your appointment.

rules.title: Bank statement history length
rules.passed_label: Bank statement covers the expected period
rules.fix: Request a statement covering the full last 6 months. Most consulates in this corridor have moved from a 3-month to a 6-month expectation.

rules.title: Sudden large deposit
rules.passed_label: No single deposit dominates the balance
rules.fix: Unexplained top-ups shortly before an application are among the most frequently cited refusal triggers in this corridor. Include documentary proof of where the money came from — a property sale deed, gratuity letter, or the sender's own statement. If it was a gift, add a sponsorship affidavit.

rules.title: Travel insurance cover is below EUR 30,000
rules.passed_label: Insurance cover meets the EUR 30,000 minimum
rules.fix: Visa Code Art. 15 sets EUR 30,000 as the minimum and it is not negotiable. Buy a policy that meets it; most Pakistani insurers sell a specific 'Schengen' product.

rules.title: Travel insurance does not cover the whole trip
rules.passed_label: Insurance covers the full travel period
rules.fix: Visa Code Art. 15 requires cover for the entire period of the intended stay. Ask the insurer to reissue the certificate covering every day from departure to return inclusive.

rules.title: Insurance does not mention repatriation cover
rules.detail: Visa Code Art. 15 requires the policy to cover repatriation for medical reasons and repatriation of remains. The certificate must state this explicitly — an officer will not assume it.
rules.fix: Ask the insurer for a certificate that states repatriation cover in writing.

rules.title: Accommodation does not start by your arrival date
rules.passed_label: Accommodation dates line up with your flights
rules.detail: Your accommodation should cover the night you arrive.
rules.fix: Extend the booking so it covers every night between arrival and departure.

rules.title: Employment letter is too old
rules.fix: Ask your employer to reissue the letter dated within a month of your appointment.

rules.title: No proof of income for your stated status
rules.detail: You selected 'employed', so the file needs documentary proof of that employment and its income.
rules.fix: Add an employment letter on company letterhead, recent salary slips, or your tax return.

rules.title: Photograph compliance
rules.fix: Photographs must meet ICAO standards under Visa Code Art. 13. Ask the studio for a compliant 35x45mm digital file taken within the last 6 months.

criteria.label: Employment letter is missing details consulates expect
criteria.passed_label: Employment letter contains the expected details
criteria.question: Does the letter state ALL of: the applicant's job title, their salary, their joining or service date, and that leave has been approved or granted for the travel period? List specifically which of these are absent.
criteria.fix: Ask your employer to reissue the letter on company letterhead covering your job title, salary, joining date, approved leave dates, and a contact person with a phone number.

criteria.label: Employment letter does not confirm you will return to your job
criteria.passed_label: Employment letter confirms return to work
criteria.question: Does the letter state that the applicant is expected to resume or return to their position after the trip?
criteria.fix: Ask your employer to add a line confirming you are expected back at work on a specific date.

criteria.label: Invitation letter is missing details consulates expect
criteria.passed_label: Invitation letter contains the expected details
criteria.question: Does the invitation state ALL of: the host's full name, their full residential address, their contact details, their relationship to the applicant, the exact dates of the intended stay, and who will cover accommodation and living costs? List which are absent.
criteria.fix: Ask your host to rewrite the invitation covering their full name and address, contact details, your relationship, your exact dates, and who is paying for what.

criteria.label: Invitation letter does not evidence the host's legal status
criteria.passed_label: Invitation letter references the host's status
criteria.question: Does the letter reference the host's own legal status in the destination country, such as citizenship, residence permit or a supporting document attached?
criteria.fix: Ask your host to attach a copy of their passport, ID card or residence permit alongside the invitation.

criteria.label: Cover letter does not clearly explain the trip
criteria.passed_label: Cover letter explains the trip clearly
criteria.question: Does the cover letter state the purpose of the visit, the intended dates, where the applicant will stay, and who is funding the trip? List which are absent.
criteria.fix: Rewrite the cover letter so it states, in order: why you are travelling, your exact dates, your accommodation, who is paying, and your ties to Pakistan.

criteria.label: Cover letter does not mention your ties to Pakistan
criteria.passed_label: Cover letter describes ties to Pakistan
criteria.question: Does the letter describe concrete ties to the home country such as employment, business, family dependants, study or property?
criteria.fix: Add a short paragraph describing your job, family and any property or business that ties you to Pakistan.

criteria.label: Sponsorship letter does not clearly state what is covered
criteria.passed_label: Sponsorship letter states what is covered
criteria.question: Does the sponsorship letter state the sponsor's full name, their relationship to the applicant, and specifically which costs they undertake to cover?
criteria.fix: Ask the sponsor to state their name, relationship to you, and exactly which expenses they will cover, and to attach their own financial evidence.
